mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 9.5% indicate a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5%) and depressed industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signal a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles characterized by near-zero federal funds rates, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as investors anticipate economic stabilization and policy support over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances during monetary easing cycles, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 600) reflect weak consumer demand for durable goods, suppressing retail sales and corporate profits, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is below 600, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate revenue growth and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 95, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
